modmenu.descriptionTranslation.betterhel: Replaces /help with a clearer, interactable, paginated list. Adds descriptions for commands and arguments, plus optional metadata from other mods.
betterhelp.commands.help.homepage_hover: Click to visit the mod's homepage
Grants one specified advancement to players.
commands.advancement.revoke.targets.only: Revokes one specified advancement from players.
commands.attribute.description: Manages or queries an entity's attributes.
commands.ban-ip.description: Adds an IP address to the banlist.
commands.bossbar.description: Creates, manages and lists boss bars.
commands.clear.targets.item.description: Clears matching items from players' inventories.
commands.clone.description: Copies blocks from one area to another.
commands.damage.description: Applies damage to a specified entity.
commands.debug.description: Starts or stops a debugging session.
commands.dialog.description: Displays or clears a dialog for players.
commands.dialog.clear.description: Clears the current dialog for players.
commands.difficulty.easy.description: Sets the difficulty level to Easy.
commands.difficulty.hard.description: Sets the difficulty level to Hard.
commands.difficulty.normal.description: Sets the difficulty level to Normal.
commands.difficulty.peaceful.description: Sets the difficulty level to Peaceful.
commands.effect.clear.targets.effect.des: Clears a specified status effect from entities.
commands.effect.give.targets.effect.desc: Applies a specified status effect to entities.
commands.enchant.description: Adds an enchantment to the main-hand item of entities.
commands.enchant.targets.enchantment.lev: Adds an enchantment with a specified level to the main-hand item of entities.
commands.fill.description: Fills an area with a specified block.
commands.fillbiome.description: Fills an area with a specified biome.
commands.gamemode.gamemode.target.descri: Sets the game mode for target players.
commands.help.description: Shows command list or detailed help for a command.
commands.locate.description: Locates the nearest structure, biome, or point of interest.
commands.me.description: Sends a message in third person.
commands.msg.description: Sends a private message to other players.
commands.pardon.description: Removes a player from the banlist.
commands.pardon-ip.description: Removes an IP address from the banlist.
commands.place.description: Places a feature, jigsaw, structure, or template.
commands.posteffect.description: Adds or removes post effects on players.
commands.publish.description: Opens a singleplayer world to LAN.
commands.random.description: Draws a random value or manages random sequences.
commands.ride.description: Makes entities ride other entities or stops entities from riding.
commands.say.description: Sends a message to other players.
commands.schedule.description: Schedules a function to run later.
commands.setidletimeout.description: Sets how long idle players stay before being kicked.
commands.spectate.description: Makes a spectator spectate an entity.
commands.teammsg.description: Sends a message to the team.
commands.tell.description: Sends a private message to other players.
commands.tellraw.description: Sends a JSON message to players.
commands.time.description: Changes or queries the world time.
commands.tm.description: Sends a message to the team.
commands.transfer.description: Transfers a player to another server.
commands.w.description: Sends a private message to other players.
commands.weather.rain.description: Sets the weather to rain (snowfall in cold biomes).
commands.weather.thunder.description: Sets the weather to thunderstorm (blizzard in cold biomes).
